name: maintenance
description: Bounded loop-until-dry maintenance sweep with explicit coverage and no-progress detection

tasks.prompt: Round {{round}} correctness/debt finder. Search for NEW verified issues not already represented in previous results. Report examined scope and caps. Objective: {{objective}} Previous: {{previous}}

Round {{round}} passive security/dependency/configuration finder. Search only for NEW confirmed reachable issues; no active techniques. Report scope/caps. Objective: {{objective}} Previous: {{previous}}
Round {{round}} quality/test/accessibility/data evidence finder. Search for NEW gaps, not final release readiness. Report scope/caps. Objective: {{objective}} Previous: {{previous}}
Round {{round}} operability/reliability/toil/cost finder using repository evidence only. Search for NEW issues and report scope/caps. Objective: {{objective}} Previous: {{previous}}

Round {{round}}: refute unsupported findings, deduplicate by root cause, compare against previous verified set, and calculate metrics.new_verified_findings and metrics.closed_blockers exactly. PASS only when complete round found zero new verified findings; otherwise COMPLETE. Inputs: {{dependencies}} Previous: {{previous}}
